criteria.text: Given `REPO_HISTORY_COLUMNS`, when it is read, then it is exactly `pullRequest, head, risk, findings, duration, cost, ran`, in that order.

Given `apps/web/app/o/[slug]/repos/[owner]/[name]/page.tsx`, when it renders Review history and its loading skeleton, then both take their columns from `REPO_HISTORY_COLUMNS` imported from `@/components/overview`, and the page defines no column list of its own.

Given `ReviewsTable` rendered with `renderToStaticMarkup`, `columns={REPO_HISTORY_COLUMNS}`, `groupByPullRequest`, and two reviews of one pull request with `costUsd` 0.12 and 0.0042, when the markup is read, then the headers are "Pull request, Head, Blast radius, Findings, Duration, Cost, When" in that order, the "Cost" header has `text-right`, and `$0.12` and `$0.0042` each appear in a different row, with no total shown.
Given a repository with reviews, when its page loads, then each Review history row's Cost matches the same review's Cost on the Reviews page.

tickets.title: Show each run's cost in a repository's Review history
tickets.goal: Export a shared REPO_HISTORY_COLUMNS list from the overview reviews table, adding the existing `cost` column between Duration and When, and have the repository page and its skeleton use it in place of the page-local HISTORY_COLUMNS. Delivers the Cost column end to end on /o/[slug]/repos/[owner]/[name], tested through ReviewsTable's rendered markup.
steps: Add `export const REPO_HISTORY_COLUMNS: readonly ReviewColumn[]` = pullRequest, head, risk, findings, duration, cost, ran in reviews-table.tsx; reuse the existing `cost` entry in COLUMNS, no new column definition
In the repo page, delete HISTORY_COLUMNS and import REPO_HISTORY_COLUMNS from `@/components/overview` for both ReviewsTable and TableCardSkeleton
Drop the now-unused `ReviewColumn` type import from the page if nothing else uses it
Tests use renderToStaticMarkup like components/review/review-summary.test.tsx; no jsdom or testing-library
AC3 no-total check: split the markup into <tr> rows; assert exactly two rows contain a `$` amount, one `$0.12` and the other `$0.0042`, and the grouped `PR #n` header row contains no `$`
Run pnpm typecheck, lint and dead-code
tickets.notes: Leave RECENT_COLUMNS (overview page) and the Reviews page COLUMNS page-local. AC2 is checked in review, AC4 by loading a repo page. apps/web work follows the vercel-react-best-practices skill.
